recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality and lack of standardized recipes during peak hours
recommendations.action: Implement strict standardized recipe cards, conduct mandatory prep training for kitchen staff, and introduce a mandatory expediter quality check before any plate leaves the kitchen.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduction in food-related complaints and improved dish consistency across all shifts.

recommendations.issue: Inefficient front-of-house management, table turnover delays, and long wait times
recommendations.action: Adopt a digital table management and reservation system to optimize seating flow, and redesign the floor plan to streamline server pathways and reduce bottlenecks.
recommendations.expected_impact: Shorter wait times for guests and faster, more predictable table turnover.

recommendations.issue: Employee burnout and inadequate customer service training due to understaffing
recommendations.action: Revise the scheduling matrix to ensure adequate staffing during peak hours, introduce a monthly customer service refresher workshop, and implement an incentive program for positive staff mentions.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved staff morale, friendlier guest interactions, and a more attentive service style.

recommendations.issue: Pricing strategy misalignment with portion sizes and overall dining experience
recommendations.action: Audit current menu item costs against portion sizes and perceived value, introducing either portion adjustments or value-focused combos to better match customer expectations.
recommendations.expected_impact: Decreased complaints regarding value for money and increased guest satisfaction with the bill.
